PUCT approved publication 2026-07-09 in Project 58000; comments were due 2026-08-11. Staff modeling: residential share of transmission cost -3.137 pts, CP-billed customers +3.294 pts. No final adoption found as of 2026-10-02; rule must be final by 2026-12-31. Retail TDU effective date not established - an effect on 2027 TDU bills (e.g., via the Sept-2027 TCRF/class-allocation update) is plausible but unconfirmed. Note the existing 2026 4CP determinants (set summer 2026) bill through 2027 under the current tariffs unless the rule changes transition.
